data.name: Haunted Gnome Shroud
data.description: When an opponent misses you due to the miss chance from Haunted Gnome Shroud, you can spend 5 stamina points to impose a -2 penalty on all that opponent's attack rolls against you until that opponent deals damage to you. This ability doesn't stack with itself.
